name: AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite
author: advisorsuite

sections.description:
AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite adds four interactive insurance calculators to your site, each available as a Gutenberg block (“AdvisorSuite Insurance Calculator”) and as a shortcode:

  • [advisorsuite_insurance calculator="life"] — life insurance needs via the DIME method (Debt, Income, Mortgage, Education)
  • [advisorsuite_insurance calculator="disability"] — disability insurance needs with waiting-period cushion
  • [advisorsuite_insurance calculator="termperm"] — term vs. permanent cost comparison (“buy term and invest the difference”)
  • [advisorsuite_insurance calculator="affordability"] — insurance premium affordability

Every calculator shows a live chart, works on mobile, defaults to CAD (visitors can switch currency), and displays the disclaimer: “For illustrative purposes only. Not insurance, investment, or tax advice. Actual premiums, benefits, and costs vary by insurer, age, health, and policy terms.”

All four are complete and unrestricted — no capped inputs, no hidden results, no license key, no upsell nag on your pages, and no time limit. All calculations run in the visitor’s browser. Nothing is uploaded, and the plugin does not contact any external service.

What this plugin does not include. Saving, CSV export, and PDF download are not built into this plugin. Neither are the critical-illness, cash-value-growth, and long-term-care calculators. Those are part of AdvisorSuite Insurance Pro, a separate paid plugin sold at https://getadvisorsuite.ca/ — you do not need it to use everything described above.

External services

This plugin does not use any external services. It makes no outbound HTTP
requests of any kind: no license checks, no payment processing, no analytics,
no remote fonts or scripts. Every calculation runs in the visitor’s browser and
nothing is transmitted off the site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  2. Add the “AdvisorSuite Insurance Calculator” block (or a shortcode) to any page.
  3. Optional: pick a default currency under Settings → AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite.
sections.faq:
Are the four calculators limited in any way?

No. They compute in full, with no capped inputs, no hidden results, and no time limit.

Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. Every calculation runs in the visitor’s browser, nothing is transmitted, and the plugin makes no external HTTP requests.

Does it add a credit link to my pages?

Only if you ask it to. Settings → AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite has a checkbox, unticked by default, that adds a “Powered by AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite” badge above the results on each calculator. Leave it unticked and nothing is added to your pages.

What data does the plugin store?

Two site options: your default currency and the attribution checkbox. Nothing else is stored, and deleting the plugin removes both.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Renamed to AdvisorSuite Insurance Lite and reduced to four calculators, each complete and unrestricted.
  • Removed all license-key, payment, and external-service code. The plugin makes no outbound requests.
  • Saving, CSV export, and PDF download are no longer part of this plugin.
  • The attribution badge is opt-in, off by default, and redesigned for the top of the results column.
  • Prefixed all functions, classes, constants, and options with adviin_/ADVIIN_.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
